Excellence & Ambition for All
Welcome to The Riverview Academy!
We are a kind, inclusive community that embraces individuality and creates opportunities for all, irrespective of gender, race, disability or background.
Through excellent education in a safe and nurturing environment, we empower every child to become the very best version of themselves.
At Riverview, our values are at the heart of everything we do.
Guided by kindness, excellence, respect, resilience, responsibility and teamwork, our children grow into confident, creative learners who make a positive difference to our school, our community, and the wider world.
All members of the school community work as a team to ensure that the time your children spend with us is positive and remembered fondly.
We provide inspiring and challenging learning opportunities to enable children to build on their previous learning as well as develop their self-confidence, independence and experience a sense of achievement at every level.
We support and enable our children to develop into well-rounded citizens of the future.

Home > Parents & Carers > Before & After School Provision
Before & After School Provision
All wraparound care sessions must be booked and paid for via Childcare Bookings for Schools – https://theriverviewacademy.cbfs.uk
Parents and carers are encouraged to book sessions in advance where it is possible to help with planning and staffing. Availability is subject to capacity and places are allocated on a first-come, first-served basis. If a session appears to be fully booked, please email enquiries@childcarebookings.co.uk. Please note that days are not transferable.
After School Care Club is run internally and we can offer an affordable, secure, fun and engaging environment for parents in need of additional childcare options in the Infant School Community Room, Monday to Friday, 3:15 pm to 6:00 pm.
Children are collected from the school at 3:15 pm by a member of Staff. The costs for each session are £8 for half session or £13 for a full session. For the later sessions there will be food provisions in place.
Bookings can be made for the following sessions Monday -Friday;
Additionally, there are many qualified childminders working in the area. More information about registered childminding services can be obtained from Gravesham Borough Council.

Home > Parents & Carers > School Day (Opening Times)
School Day (Opening Times)
EYFS & KS1
Total Number of Hours (per week): 32 hours & 5 minutes
Morning Gate: 8.40 – 8.50am
Start of the Day (Registration): 8.50am
End of the Day: 3.15pm
KS2
Total Number of Hours (per week): 33 hours & 20 minutes
Children should not arrive at school too early in the morning, as the gates are not opened until 8.40am. It is essential that children use the correct paths and entrances.
Parents and carers are not allowed to drive onto the school property without a special permit from the headteacher.
Parents and Carers are asked to use the pedestrian entrance path to the school, via the Cimba Wood gate should they wish to attend a meeting or visit the school office.
We are very security conscious at the school, and the only entry point for visitors leads into the reception lobby at the main entrance. We request that parents remain in this area until one of our colleagues becomes free to attend to them. Access beyond this point is regulated by a security card. All other entrances are securely locked under the same system.
Morning Gate: 8.40 – 8.50am
Start of the Day (Registration): 8.50am
End of the Day: 3.30pm

Home > Parents & Carers > Remote Learning
Remote Learning
If in the event the school closes, we will put in place remote learning for your child.
Pupil Expectations
All children who are learning remotely will be expected to engage in the activities that we are providing – this is to ensure continuity and progress in the learning they are undertaking. Children will also be able to submit pieces of learning on Google Classroom (including pictures of their paper-based learning or digitally created learning). This will be reviewed and monitored by the class teacher.
Parent Support
We understand that supporting children with remote learning can be very challenging and places a tremendous burden on parents and carers, especially in families where there are multiple school-age children. The school intends to support you as much as it can. Parents and carers can contact their child’s class teacher either via Class Dojo or by emailing the office.
Teacher Support
Class teachers will be available to provide feedback via Google Classroom. Engagement and progress will be tracked by the pupils’ class teachers and the Senior Leadership team.

Headteacher Welcome
Welcome To The Riverview Academy!
As the Headteacher of The Riverview Academy, it is with great pride that I welcome you to our school community.
At The Riverview Academy, we are dedicated to providing an educational experience tailored to the unique needs of every child. Our vision is to ensure excellence and ambition for all!
At The Riverview Academy, we believe that education has the power to transform lives.
Our curriculum is designed to offer a broad and balanced education, rich in real-life experiences and opportunities that ignite curiosity and creativity.
We are committed to ensuring that every child feels a sense of accomplishment across a wide range of subjects and activities, fostering both academic success and personal growth.
We celebrate the individuality of each child, providing the support they need throughout their unique educational journey.
Our dedicated staff and children share a genuine love of learning, thriving in an environment built on our core values: Excellence, Kindness, Respect, Resilience, Responsibility & Teamwork.
These values guide us in creating a caring and inclusive atmosphere where every child can flourish.
I invite you to explore our website and discover more about the exciting life at The Riverview Academy.
If you are considering joining our fantastic community, we would be delighted to arrange a visit and tour.
